summary.zh: 绳子把两人的移动连在一起，伙伴既能拉你上去，也会被你拖下去。
summary.en: A tether links movement: a partner can pull you upward or be dragged down with you.

rules.zh: 角色之间有长度受限的物理连接，超过距离会产生牵拉。玩家协调站位、起跳和支撑，用连接把一个人的移动传给另一个人；失误也会沿连接影响全队。
rules.en: A limited physical link pulls characters when stretched. Players coordinate positions, jumps and anchors to transfer motion; mistakes can propagate through the same link.

loop.en: Choose who anchors and who moves
Jump together or swing for momentum

decisions.zh: 一起跳容易互相干扰，要不要让一人先站稳当支点？
decisions.en: Jump together or secure one player as an anchor first?

decisions.zh: 抢救正在掉落的伙伴，还是先稳住自己避免两人一起掉？
decisions.en: Pull a falling partner immediately or secure yourself first?

effect.zh: 短绳要求贴近配合，长绳给摆荡空间也更难预判。
effect.en: Short links require close coordination; long ones enable wider swings but are harder to predict.

effect.zh: 回退太远会把练习变成重复赶路，应匹配操作难度。
effect.en: Large setbacks can turn practice into repeated travel; match them to control difficulty.

contrast.zh: 《面包和年糕》突出一人固定、一人摆荡；《Chained Together》还要考虑三维平台如何挡住或改变链条路径。
contrast.en: Bread & Fred emphasizes anchoring and swinging; Chained Together also makes 3D platform geometry affect the chain’s route.

combination.zh: 设计提案：把抓钩锚点换成另一个玩家；先只做二维固定绳长，观察双方能否一起找到摆荡节奏。
combination.en: Design proposal: replace a grapple anchor with another player, beginning with a fixed-length 2D rope to test shared swinging rhythm.

setup.zh: 编辑示例：两人被三米绳连接，B够不到对面平台，A身后有安全地面。
setup.en: Editorial example: a three-meter rope joins A and B; B cannot reach the next platform and A has safe ground behind them.

action.zh: A后退固定，B走下边缘摆荡，接近最高点时跳向平台。
action.en: A anchors behind the edge while B swings below it and jumps near the top of the arc.

result.zh: B落稳后绳子绷紧，变成A接下来借力的支点。
result.en: B lands securely and becomes the next anchor for A.

next.zh: 两人交换职责，把同样的方法用到下一个缺口。
next.en: They swap roles and apply the method to the next gap.

firstStep.zh: 先做二维两人、三个平台、一条固定长度绳和明确的固定动作，只支持本机双人。
firstStep.en: Build two local 2D characters, three platforms, a fixed-length rope and an explicit anchor action.

pitfall.zh: 先避免绳子缠绕与三维碰撞；物理失控或联网延迟会让失败难以归因。
pitfall.en: Defer rope wrapping and 3D collisions; unstable physics or network delay can make failure hard to understand.

test.zh: 试玩者能预测谁会被拉动，并在失败后主动改变支点或起跳顺序。
test.en: Testers can predict who will be pulled and adjust the anchor or jump order after failure.
